principles.title: Beyond the core
principles.text: We are looking for distillery outliers. If you want the typical distillery profile, buy a core-range bottling!

principles.title: From distilleries with love
principles.text: We prefer to select our casks directly from distilleries. This limits our choice, but gives us something we value even more: a personal connection with the people behind the whisky.

principles.title: Ready to enjoy together
principles.text: Since 2022, CMWS has focused on mature whisky ready for immediate bottling, rather than speculative long-term cask ownership with an uncertain outcome.
